    Bookmark

    BookmarkStore
    The in-memory bookmark collection: add / edit / remove / list plus folder and URL lookups.
    BrowserPanel
    The Swing face of the browser: a tab strip, a navigation toolbar (back / forward / reload / stop / home, a smart address bar, bookmarks, find, zoom, view-source, downloads, history, settings), a JFXPanel hosting the JavaFX FxBrowser scene, and a status / progress bar.
    BrowserPreviewPanel
    The 3D desktop's face of the Web Browser: a pure-Swing static preview.
    BrowserSettings
    Application-wide browser preferences, persisted as JSON by BrowserStore and applied to every WebEngine the panel creates.
    BrowserStore
    JSON persistence for the web browser: the BrowserSettings, the bookmarks, the history, the downloads and the open-tab session (a list of URLs restored on next launch).
    ContentDisposition
    Parses a Content-Disposition response header to recover the server's suggested file name, so downloads are named correctly instead of guessing from the URL path.
    DownloadRecord
    A file the browser has fetched (or is fetching): the source URL, the local file name it was saved under, the transfer size, a DownloadRecord.Status and the timestamp.
    DownloadRecord.Status
    The lifecycle of a download.
    EncodingFallback
    Pure helpers behind the Web Browser's blank-page workaround.
    ErrorPage
    Renders a self-contained, styled HTML error page for a LoadFailure, so a failed navigation shows an honest, actionable card (what went wrong, why, a "Try again" button when retrying makes sense, and recovery tips) instead of a blank page or a bare status-bar string.
    ExtensionManagerDialog
    The in-browser extension manager: a modal Swing dialog listing every discovered BrowserExtension, letting the user enable/disable each, inspect and edit the granted permissions, rescan, and open the third-party extensions folder.
    FindScript
    Builds the JavaScript that powers the inline find bar (highlight-all with a live "n of m" match count, next/prev cycling and clear) and parses the count the script returns.
    FxBrowser
    The JavaFX half of the browser: one WebView (WebKit) per tab, all created and driven on the JavaFX Application Thread.
    FxBrowser.Listener
    Receives state changes, always on the JavaFX Application Thread.
    HistoryEntry
    One visited page in the browsing history: the URL, the page title at the time of the visit, a visit count and the timestamp of the most recent visit.
    HistoryStore
    The in-memory browsing history: a de-duplicated, capacity-capped list kept newest-first.
    Html
    Minimal, dependency-free HTML escaping shared by the browser's own generated pages (the load-failure ErrorPage and the ReaderExtractor reader view).
    LoadFailure
    A classified page-load (or download) failure: a LoadFailure.Reason plus the URL that failed and an optional specific detail (an exception message or an HTTP status line).
    LoadFailure.Reason
    The kind of failure, with its presentation text and retry policy.
    ReaderArticle
    An article extracted for reader mode: a title, an optional byline and the body paragraphs, all as plain text.
    ReaderExtractor
    Reader mode: a small readability-style extractor plus the clean, ad-free page it renders.
    SearchEngine
    The search engines the smart address bar can fall back to when the typed text is not a URL (see UrlNormalizer).
    SecurityInfo
    Classifies a URL's connection security for the address-bar indicator and the site-info popup: SecurityInfo.Level.SECURE (https), SecurityInfo.Level.NOT_SECURE (http/ftp), SecurityInfo.Level.LOCAL (file or loopback host), SecurityInfo.Level.INTERNAL (about/data/blob/view-source/javascript) or SecurityInfo.Level.UNKNOWN.
    SecurityInfo.Level
    The connection-security level of a URL.
    SiteStats
    Per-site counters of what the browser's protections blocked, shown in the site-info popup: navigations blocked and popups blocked, keyed by host.
    SiteStats.Counts
    An immutable snapshot of one host's blocked counts.
    TabModel
    The tab-strip model: an ordered list of tabs with an active index.
    TabModel.Tab
    One browser tab: a stable id plus the display title and current URL.
    UrlNormalizer
    The smart address bar's resolution logic, isolated from any UI so it can be unit-tested headless.
    WebBrowser
    The Web Browser application's 3D-desktop entry point (Start Menu → Internet → Web Browser).
    WebBrowserApp
    The full browser as a top-level JFrame: a BrowserPanel in its own window.
